MutationContext.description: Metadata every mutation must carry so retries and stale edits are safe.

description: Request payload for the `ticket.schedule` command: hold qualified work until its activation (DR-LC-09). The optional Schedule facts — activation instant, timezone, and eligible profile — arrive together or not at all, and land the one-time Schedule that makes the Ticket ready when its moment arrives (DR-SA-01, DR-SA-03).

profile.description: The Execution Profile eligible once the activation fires.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone the Schedule lives in.

title: TicketScheduleRequest
